Element 16 was selected for this exclusive event in Boston, Massachusetts, where Element 16 met with some of the largest industrial corporate energy venture investors one-on-one, including Bosch, Equinor, and PTT Chemical. Industrial Decarbonization and Electrification a. Middle East Sulfur Conference. Element 16 was invited to speak on the main stage of the Middle East Sulfur Conference in both 2024 and 2025. Attendees included many of the world’s largest industrial heat consumers as well as largest sulfur producers. This led to meetings with potential corporate pilot site partners and investors. b. ADIPEC. Element 16 spoke at, likely, the world’s largest energy event in Abu Dhabi in 2024. Element 16 was invited to speak as part of the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company’s (ADNOC) Sulfur Innovation Challenge. Element 16 has continued further discussions with ADNOC, which could be a technology/pilot user, sulfur expertise partner, and/or financier. c. UC Davis Industrial Decarbonization Symposium. Element 16 has attended multiple industrial energy events hosted by UC Davis. At the most recent event, Element 16 learned about significant advancements in electrification of industrial process heat in Page 64 of 87 DE-EE0009329 Element 16 Technologies, Inc. Europe, and the different business models being explored in Denmark. This event led to a new understanding of how sulfur thermal energy storage could be deployed in Northern Europe to electrify industrial heat with better economics than even in places with excellent solar resources like California. d. San Francisco ScaleUp Summit. After selection interviews, Element 16 was invited to events hosted by Italian companies and government in San Francisco. Element 16 was able to meet with the largest Italian energy companies like Enel, Eni, and Italgas. Element 16 also met with other large European corporations, which led to direct follow-up discussions. Government Agency a. SETO Peer Review. Element 16 was invited to speak on a panel as part of the US Department of Energy Solar Energy Technology Office Peer Review. Element 16 supplied information about the sulfur thermal energy storage work underway to one of the largest supporting government agencies in 2024. This event offered exposure to a national audience of government and research groups near Washington, DC. b. CEC/EPRI Electrification Summit. Element 16 presented on a panel on the topic of industrial heat decarbonization in Sacramento, CA. Element 16 met other technology innovators, including fellow panelist from Skyven, which is developing high temperature heat pumps. Also in Sacramento, Element 16 hosted a booth at the EPIC Symposium. c. HPC4EI Workshop hosted by Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL). Karthik Nithyanandam was invited to speak at this event in-person at LLNL. This was a presentation of Element 16’s work in collaboration with the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), which made use of its supercomputing capabilities to model the new molten sulfur technology. NREL has profiled this work in collaboration with Element 16.
